summary: Ssemble is a collaborative online video editor with AI tools for summarizing, transcribing, and enhancing videos, ideal for teams and educators.
description:
Ssemble is a collaborative online video editor with AI tools for summarizing, transcribing, and enhancing videos, ideal for teams and educators.

Turn YouTube videos into viral TikTok & Instagram Shorts with AI. Auto-clip, caption, and post. Trusted by 2.4M+ creators. Plans from $6/mo.

Collaborative editing: Multiple users can work on the same video project in real time, streamlining team workflows. Transcription and subtitles: AI generates editable transcripts and subtitles for improved accessibility and SEO. Video summarization: Automatically condense long-form content into short, shareable highlights. Plugin marketplace: Extend Ssemble with add-ons for effects, integrations, and custom tools.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Log In
howToUse.description: Visit Ssemble and create a free account. Log in to your dashboard to start new projects or join team workspaces.

howToUse.title: Create or Join a Project
howToUse.description: Start a new video editing project or join an existing team project. Invite collaborators if you’re working as a team.

howToUse.title: Upload Video Files
howToUse.description: Upload your source media files (video, audio, images) to the project workspace. Ssemble supports all major video formats.

howToUse.title: Edit Collaboratively in Real Time
howToUse.description: Edit the timeline, cut or merge clips, add transitions, overlays, and effects. Multiple users can work together live on the same timeline.

howToUse.title: Use AI Tools for Transcription & Summarization
howToUse.description: Generate automatic transcripts and subtitles for your videos. Use the AI summarization feature to create highlight reels from long-form content.

howToUse.title: Explore Plugin Marketplace
howToUse.description: Install plugins for advanced effects, integrations (like YouTube or Google Drive), or custom workflow enhancements.

howToUse.title: Preview, Export, and Share
howToUse.description: Preview your final video, export in the desired resolution and format, and share via link or direct download.
